gist: US media report the FBI is investigating an apparent criminal database breach.
The breach follows recent tech outages and a previous alleged attack by ShinyHunters.
NBC reports a separate cyberattack targeted the US Department of Agriculture.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Media reports indicate the FBI is looking into an apparent compromise of its criminal information system. This follows earlier claims by a cyber-crime group regarding bureau staff data, and reports of a separate incident targeting a department farm payment system.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The potential exposure of sensitive law enforcement and bureau personnel information raises serious safety concerns, while coming amid heightened scrutiny following recent technology blackouts across several US sectors.
